editorial:
Imagine waking up from surgery feeling great about your new look, only to find out your doctor is actually a crazy cult leader. You get a wild ride with a woman who just wanted a boost in confidence but ended up as a pawn in a plan to bring ancient monsters to Earth. It is a weird mix of a goofy comedy and a monster movie that does not take itself too seriously. The vibe is totally over-the-top, making it feel like a B-movie from the old days where everything is just a bit too much, but in a fun way.

You will notice the acting is pretty campy, which fits the story perfectly. The special effects are a bit rough, but that actually adds to the charm. If you like stories that are totally random and a bit gross, you will love this. It is a great pick for a movie night with friends who enjoy weird stuff. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you like owning discs, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch. Streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video is also a solid choice for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: Everything goes crazy when the implants turn out to be portals for the elder gods. The main character finds herself fighting off tentacles and cultists in a messy battle. After a lot of screaming and chaos, she manages to stop the ritual and defeat the evil doctor. She ends up surviving the nightmare, though she learns the hard way that some beauty shortcuts are way too dangerous for your own good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves campy horror and weird creature features.
